normal_timing_separate.timing_scope: packing + synchronous SDK set/run/get/copy/release + official CPU pose codec; hashing/saving/init excluded

priority.scope: Small exact deployment check, not a 20Hz solution

priority.validation: All three CPU refs + owned full SDK I/O arrays, actual profiles/targets, controlled same-process timing; no carried previous pose.

priority.action: Reduce redundant rank/layout transfers and express fixed-position RoPE as equivalent permutation/sign operations; keep QK norms and all positions. Evaluate core-wise head partition for all 6 SDPA heads, preserving full key domain.
priority.current_measured_budget: Block layout NPU150-159 ms, CPU55-101 ms; RoPE96-103 ms; SDPA239-243 ms all core0-only. These costs are diagnostic row sums.

priority.action: Cache the overlapping reference image prefix before camera-token replacement (patch embedding and blocks0-3), bound to exact pixels/normalization/weights/role-independent prefix. Recompute blocks4-11 for the new pair.
priority.current_measured_budget: The entire TWO-view reusable prefix is233-286 ms; saved ONE-view cost requires measurement. After first global block, all later outputs depend on the new image; no exact old KV/geometry reuse.

data.feasibility_conclusion: Exact graph rewrites and lower-frequency depth can help deployment but this captured 252x336 pair cannot meet20Hz by removing CPU fallback or splitting only heads. A 50ms new-observation pose path requires a separately validated much smaller/causal learned computation or a major approximation, with explicit model/quality acceptance; not an implementation-equivalent guarantee. Full depth may be scheduled2-5s, but that does not supply20Hz fresh pose.
limits: SDK operator times are profiled diagnostics, not controlled normal wall time. Counterfactuals hold all other row times fixed and are neither hardware theoretical lower bounds nor speed guarantees.
Profile runs are three different pairs and may have different CPU state; do not average them into a sustained benchmark.
S=2 emits two poses for one overlapping pair; counting both outputs does not mean two independent fresh observations.
DPT removal does not shorten the pose backbone. Global blocks mix both views; cache after global changes model semantics.
CPU input/outputs table costs do not include all Python/SDK codec, scheduling or sensor latency. 50ms is the throughput budget;100ms P95 end-to-end requires separate source-to-pose evidence.
DA3-small is a different pretrained model. Its CPU/FP16 geometric quality is not an accepted originalVGGT replacement. No tracking architecture or production configuration changed.

small_exact_changes_are_not_20Hz_solutio.MLP_sharding: All 12 original MLP row sums are67.639-68.215 ms. Even setting all MLP row costs to zero saves only8.62-8.65% of complete NPU rows; do not prioritize another MLP-only variant for20Hz.
small_exact_changes_are_not_20Hz_solutio.camera_decode_layout: Its54-55ms transpose is a measured layout hotspot; even deleting that row entirely changes the recorded complete profiled cost by only4.78-5.08%. The entire NPU camera-decoder tail, including concatenation/layout, is1.87-2.05ms.
small_exact_changes_are_not_20Hz_solutio.pose_only: Separating dense outputs removes about20.6-20.95% of current profiled rows, not95% needed to approach50ms.
